items.description: Report does not define which callers are authorized to invoke rebalanceFunds(); the authorization predicate is left as the report's qualitative 'only authorized callers' requirement.

Report gives no concrete balances, amounts, or numeric bounds defining when the vault is under-collateralized or how long the window lasts; the under-collateralization and redemption-failure observables are therefore qualitative Booleans.
Report gives no concrete excess amount or balance values, so the double-drain is represented only by the report-stated occurrence of excess being drained twice.

Report states reentrancy and double-drain are conditional on the custodian being a contract and the token being ERC777/callback-enabled; these are encoded as preconditions rather than established facts.
